column4: Guards cleat#3838: a run compacted repeatedly replays the history it recorded. A registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set, 2026-11-14.
